summary.name: Sketches
summary.one_liner: Sketches is a digital drawing and painting app from Tayasui, listed under Design Tools in the awesome-mac list.
use_cases: making accurate drawings with a guide layer
summary.what_it_does: Sketches is a digital drawing tool aimed at realistic sketching and painting. Its Wet Watercolor brush lets colors flow and blend, and it is said to emulate acrylic or oil painting. It supports unlimited layers, a guide layer for accurate drawing, and blending between two colors with a color selector. Users can rotate the canvas with two fingers, open two apps side by side and drag layers or documents between them, and organize drawings in folders. Drawings can be backed up to and synced through iCloud.
notable: Wet Watercolor brush with realistic color flow and blending
Unlimited layers and a guide layer for accurate drawing
Two-finger canvas rotation and split-app drag and drop
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform support beyond iCloud-based sync is not detailed on the page
